logsOff.logsAreOffForThisProject: Logs are off for this project
logsOff.notLogged: Supermixer doesn’t run Logflare and Vector for this project, so nothing is being logged.
logsOff.turnLogsOnUnder: Turn logs on under Settings › Infrastructure.

logsView.supabaseCollectsLogsWithVectorAnd: Supabase collects logs with Vector and stores them with Logflare, which the self-hosted stack only starts with docker-compose.logs.yml. Start the stack with that file, and logs appear here.
logsView.thisStackDoesnTRunLog: This stack doesn't run log analytics
logsView.noLogEntriesInThisTime: No log entries in this time range

requestsReport.theRequestReportsComeFromThe: The request reports come from the API gateway's logs.
requestsReport.theyComeFromTheApiGateway: They come from the API gateway's logs, which a self-hosted stack keeps only when it runs Logflare and Vector (docker-compose.logs.yml).

advisorsChanges.takeSnapshotsOfThisProjectS: take snapshots of this project's database
advisorsChanges.afterASuspectFunctionDeployOr: After a suspect function deploy, or after someone with access leaves, rotating keys isn't enough: check the database for anything left behind that could let them back in. This compares it now with a snapshot from before.
advisorsChanges.youNeedAccessToThisProject: You need access to this project's keys to review its database changes
advisorsChanges.aSnapshotRecordsFingerprintsOfThe: A snapshot records fingerprints of the database’s roles, SECURITY DEFINER functions, triggers, event triggers, cron jobs and Auth users’ passwords and roles (hashes only). Supermixer takes one before each Edge Function deploy; take one now to compare with later.
advisorsChanges.changesToRolePasswordsAndCron: Changes to role passwords, and cron jobs of other roles, can't be seen this way. Check those where the stack runs.
advisorsChanges.readAsTheProjectSDatabase: Read as the project's database user, not a superuser
advisorsChanges.sinceThisSnapshotCheckThatEach_one: {{count}} change since this snapshot ({{relativeTime}}). Check that it's yours; anything you don't recognise may be a way back in.
advisorsChanges.sinceThisSnapshotCheckThatEach_other: {{count}} changes since this snapshot ({{relativeTime}}). Check that each is yours; anything you don't recognise may be a way back in.

advisorsPerformance.missingAndUnusedIndexesSlowPolicies: Missing and unused indexes, slow policies and other things that make queries slower than they need to be.

advisorsQueryPerformance.whichStatementsCostTheDatabaseThe: Which statements cost the database the most time.
advisorsQueryPerformance.queryPerformanceReadsItsStatisticsSupaba: Query Performance reads its statistics. Supabase stacks load it at startup; if enabling fails, add it to shared_preload_libraries and restart Postgres.
advisorsQueryPerformance.whichStatementsCostTheDatabaseThe2: Which statements cost the database the most time, from pg_stat_statements.
advisorsQueryPerformance.postgresShowsOtherRolesStatementsOnly: Postgres shows other roles' statements only to members of pg_read_all_stats. Read-only access uses a login without it, so statements that may hold secrets, such as ALTER ROLE … PASSWORD, stay hidden.
advisorsQueryPerformance.runAsConstantsAreReplacedBy: Run as {{role}}. Constants are replaced by $1, $2, … so similar queries are counted together.
advisorsQueryPerformance.clearsPgStatStatementsForThe: Clears pg_stat_statements for the whole database server. Statistics start collecting again from now.

advisorsSecurity.settingsAndObjectsThatCouldExpose: Settings and objects that could expose data through the API, such as tables without Row Level Security.

logsExplorer.searchTheLogsOfEveryService: Search the logs of every service in the stack.

observabilityApi.requestsThroughTheStackSApi: Requests through the stack's API gateway over the last 24 hours, from its logs. Refreshes every minute.

observability.liveFiguresFromPostgresSStatistics: Live figures from Postgres's statistics, refreshed every 10 seconds.

logs.everyRequestThroughTheApiGateway: Every request through the API gateway.
logs.theConnectionPoolerSelfHostedStacks: The connection pooler. Self-hosted stacks only ship these when Vector is set up to collect them.
logs.theEdgeRuntimeFunctionOutputAnd: The Edge Runtime: function output and errors.
logs.signUpsSignInsAndThe: Sign-ups, sign-ins and the Auth server.
logs.pgCronSLinesInThe: pg_cron's lines in the Postgres log.
